title: Bi'r Minayh
description: Multi-period site surrounding a well in Wadi Minayh, eastern Egypt. The site includes a mining settlement or Christian lavra dated to the 4th-6th centuries CE, an earlier Pharaonic settlement, and numerous inscriptions from the Old, Middle, and New Kingdom periods.

properties.description: Point representing the visible remains of the Late Antique structures at Bir Minayh, after Desert Networks 2020.
